leaves.name: picRepresentableLFTAbVar
leaves.doc: pic-repr: the relative Picard fppf sheaf of an abelian variety over a field is representable by a scheme locally of finite type (Murre 1964, Oort 1962; FGA Exp. 232 Thm 3.1; Kleiman, The Picard scheme, Thm 9.4.8 with 9.2.5; BLR 8.2 Thm 3; locators UNVERIFIED). Replaces picRepresentableAbVar; also discharges pic-dict's PicDict.PicLocFinType (PicRepr.picLocFinType_of_lft).
leaves.source: Murre 1964, Oort 1962; FGA Exp. 232 Thm 3.1; Kleiman, The Picard scheme, Thm 9.4.8 with 9.2.5; BLR, Neron models, 8.2 Thm 3: Pic_{X/k} of X proper over a field is represented by a group scheme locally of finite type (locators UNVERIFIED)
